items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: Rick, I'll put you in charge of seeing if it picks our voices up.

ctx.x: Could I run it by? It looks like the real's walked, I thought.
Rick, I'll put you in charge of seeing if it picks our voices up.
Okay? All right. Yeah. You think the microphone's gone bad? It's hardly picking my voice up at all.
